title: Learned optimizer for Mirror coordinates only
hypothesis: A learned per-step diagonal update schedule acting only on a 2D Mirror code reaches at least 10% lower fresh query NRMSE than development-tuned Adam and SGD after four updates on held-out linear tasks.
mirror_coordinate: 2D task vector m updated by learned coordinatewise step-size schedule
logical_multiplicity: few-shot linear functions adapted through two Mirror coordinates
controls: learned per-coordinate gradient schedule on same code

paid_objects: learned optimizer schedule or Adam/SGD hyperparameter serialization

success_gate: Every fresh world at step4: learned schedule query NRMSE <= 0.90x best development-tuned standard optimizer, with exact serialized policy+code bytes no larger than Adam policy+code.
failure_gate: Any world misses quality/byte gate or learned schedule is matched by tuned SGD/Adam.
boundaries: Synthetic linear few-shot mechanism test only.
The optimizer learns only update multipliers; it does not change model weights or task code dimension.
No natural task, nonlinear model, or capacity claim.
